NEW packages/main/src/tasks/docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke.ts: a wrapper-root (metadataRoot != gitRoot) regression that drives runReviewCliGates end-to-end plus a direct runDocsDriftGate root-contrast, proven RED against the pre-fix wiring. packages/main/src/tasks/gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts: a focused review-preflight-specific guard that balanced-paren-extracts the runDocsDriftGate(...) call and asserts its repoRoot is gitCwd (not a metadataRoot forward), with self-tests + coverage doc. package.json + packages/main/package.json: wired test:docs-drift-wrapper-root AND test:gitroot-cwd-contract into the root npm test chain (what lattice validate runs).

expectedOutcome: Wrapper-root REVIEW->TEST preflight: [docs-drift] pass (no false missing-path drift), REVIEW->TEST proceeds; plain repo byte-identical; the wrapper-root regression and guard run green in the battery and go RED if the fix is reverted.

outcomeDiff: No difference — expected equals actual. Wrapper-root layouts no longer false-block REVIEW->TEST, plain-repo behavior unchanged, regression+guard wired into the battery and proven RED against the pre-fix wiring.
limitations: The CHK-003 guard is review-preflight-specific (single file, single docs-drift gate call), not a general repo-wide dataflow guard; it does not catch param-named metadataRoot forwards into other gates/files (a full lexical/AST rewrite was judged impractical and out of scope, documented in the guard coverage block). DEFERRED out of scope by user decision: the english-artifacts gate storyDir metadata-root mismatch (finding #3, separate story) and the express-channel docstring drift (#2, separate story) — both confirmed UNTOUCHED.
pitfalls: (1) The DONE/REVIEW gate is fail-closed on stale review-run bindings: every source-changing fix-commit (the F-001/F-002 review-fix commit) stales the entire round and forces DEV->REVIEW round 2 + re-running all reviewers for fresh bindings — budget for this. (2) verificationEvidence stales on each head move (fix-commit, main merge); use lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale (reruns the cited command) then re-validate. (3) A wrapper-root regression needs a NON-trivial metadataRoot: a bare non-git metadataRoot makes git grep exit 128 = swallowed-as-skipped (not a missing-path FAIL), so the fixture models metadataRoot as an OUTER git repo with the gitRoot in a subdir — the faithful real-world wrapper-root case. (4) test:gitroot-cwd-contract was historically NOT in the root npm test chain (only test:all auto-discovery), so lattice validate did not run it until CHK-003/review-fix wired it in — verify guard smokes are in the npm test chain, not just test:all. (5) main moved 162 commits (incl B-40eb koala sweep) during the story; merge main before DONE and re-refresh evidence.
